name: manual_848071
claim: When scrubbing private identity from Git history while another agent owns a worktree, wait for the partner's final push, use the final remote tip as the cleanroom scrub base, then force-with-lease only from that observed SHA so previous history stays attached and partner work is preserved.

decisions.notes: The 2026-07-18 PR258 scrub first produced a divergent local rewrite; after coordinating with Claude, the scrub was rebuilt from the final Claude-pushed tip in a disposable cleanroom clone before push.
